insight: Reads pages with vision + LLMs instead of brittle XPath/CSS selectors, so automations survive site redesigns; AGPL-3.0 licensed.
name: Skyvern
tagline: Automate browser-based workflows on any website with AI.
description: An AI agent that completes browser workflows — form fills, logins, data extraction, multi-step flows — by combining computer vision with LLMs rather than hand-written selectors, so a single agent generalizes across sites it has never seen. Run it via the cloud app and API or self-host the open-source engine; bring your own model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or local Ollama).
